name: Purple Entertainment Limited
summary: Headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, Purple Agrotech Industries Limited, established in 1974, offers a diverse array of services within the entertainment, media, and film production industries. Its core activities encompass the creation of short films and advertising commercials, alongside comprehensive advertising management. The company also specializes in organizing a wide range of live events, including concerts, award ceremonies, corporate seminars, and product launch promotions. Furthermore, it provides professional photography services for portfolios and models, and manages various social and corporate functions such as weddings, company meetings, casual gatherings, and birthday parties. Formerly known as Purple Entertainment Limited, the company is scheduled to adopt its current name, Purple Agrotech Industries Limited, in November 2025.
